overall.summary: All three failures are the same problem. The ProductPage page object looks for the "Add to cart" button by data-testid 'add-bag-button', but the storefront renders it as 'add-product-button'. The button itself works as the tests expect: it is disabled with the text "Select variant" until a variant is picked, then shows "Add to cart". The cause is a stale locator in the automation code (automation defect), not an application bug. This push did not touch the page object or the storefront, so when the mismatch was introduced is unverified.
